meta.title: ReviewDesk | Code Review as a Service
meta.description: Upload a ZIP of your repository or single files. ReviewDesk runs static analysis and an AI code review in the background and returns a prioritised list of findings.

footer.madeWith: ReviewDesk · static analysis + AI review for any codebase.

hero.title: Upload your code. Get a prioritised review in minutes.
hero.description: ReviewDesk takes a ZIP of your repository or a handful of files, runs deterministic security and quality checks, then lets Claude review the code like a senior engineer. Findings come back ranked from critical to info, with a concrete fix for each.

highlights.auth: Background processing, no waiting on the page

features.title: How a review works
features.description: Three stages, fully automated. You upload once and come back to a ranked list of issues.

authSecurity.title: 1. Upload
authSecurity.description: Drop a ZIP export of a repository or individual source files. Vendored code, build output, lockfiles and binaries are filtered out automatically.

dashboardFoundation.title: 2. Analyse in the background
dashboardFoundation.description: A worker unpacks the upload, runs static rules for secrets, injection, unsafe calls and leftovers, then sends the code to the AI reviewer in batches. Progress is visible live.

developerErgonomics.title: 3. Read prioritised findings
developerErgonomics.description: Every finding has a priority, a category, the exact file and line, an explanation and a suggested fix. Filter by priority, source or file.

pricing.title: Self-hosted and under your control
pricing.description: ReviewDesk runs on your own infrastructure: Postgres, Redis and S3-compatible storage. Bring your own Anthropic API key or run static analysis only.
pricing.additional: Switch the AI reviewer off per review when you only need the deterministic checks.
